The test image shows a severely desiccated, brown, shriveled mango leaf — completely dried out and twisted, with no green tissue remaining. This pattern (tip and margin necrosis progressing inward, leading to complete drying and curling) is characteristic of Die_Back, where shoot/leaf tissue dies from the tip back.

Let me view one reference image to confirm.

The Die_Back reference matches extremely well: same completely dried/brown shriveled leaf, same twisted/curled form, same total desiccation with no green tissue, same white background presentation. The test image is a nearly identical presentation — a completely dead, brown, twisted mango leaf consistent with Die_Back disease.
